definition: Recognized sales revenue at the stated equipment/business scope.
Sales volume from the filing table; not assumed to equal shipments.
Production during the period; not nameplate capacity.
Reported closing inventory, not active installed base.
New orders booked, in the reported monetary or equipment-count unit; not revenue, closing backlog or non-binding purchase intentions.

Dispatched during the period, in the source-reported equipment-count or monetary unit; not necessarily accepted or revenue recognized. Monetary shipment values preserve the issuer valuation basis and conditional first-tool acceptance; they are not physical volumes.
Original production-and-shipment wording; retained as a separate metric.
Cumulative production-and-shipment wording; no active-base inference.
Cumulative installations claimed by supplier; not necessarily active base.
Lifetime shipments; no retirement adjustment and not installed base.
Source-reported difference between stocks; not computed from censored milestones.
Number of customers with production use reported during a period.
Reported production lines; not customer or tool counts.
Estimated total revenue/purchases in a named market definition.
Publisher-estimated share with explicit denominator/population definition.
Reported investment during period in named R&D project; includes capitalized amounts where stated.
Reported cumulative investment in named R&D project.
Company-stated expected total investment scale, a plan not realized spending.
Company-wide reported R&D investment, including expensed and capitalized amounts where disclosed; distinct from income-statement R&D expense and named-project spending.
Research and development investment expensed during the reporting period, as classified by the issuer.
Research and development investment capitalized during the reporting period, as classified by the issuer.

Current stated nameplate or service-processing capacity at the as-of date; not actual output. Two unit dimensions, deliberately not interchangeable: wafer_per_month for a wafer-processing or service line, and system_per_year for an equipment maker's own tool-building capacity. planned_production_capacity carries the same pair for capacity conditional on a project.

Issuer-stated future capacity conditional on a named project reaching full production; not current capacity or actual output. For an explicitly stated future attainment year, annual period_status identifies that target year, not achieved capacity. Equipment-manufacturing systems per year remain distinct from wafer-processing capacity.
Issuer-reported orders on hand (在手订单) at the stated disclosure date or other explicit as-of date, in the reported monetary or equipment-count unit; not new orders or recognized revenue.
Issuer-reported operating cost corresponding to the stated revenue scope and period; not capital expenditure or equipment unit price.
Issuer-reported gross margin for the stated revenue/cost scope and period; retained as reported rather than recomputed.
Net profit attributable to owners of the listed company, as reported.
Net cash flow from operating activities, as reported.

Issuer-reported total R&D expenditure in a financial-note 研发支出 table, explicitly comprising that table's expensed and capitalized R&D expenditure. Source-native accounting-note metric; do not assume equivalence to management-report R&D investment, income-statement R&D expense or named-project spending.
Signed general net profit reported for the stated subsidiary/company scope; distinct from attributable profit.
Source-reported cumulative equipment orders in stated scope.
Equipment acceptances during period.
Source-reported customer count at stated as-of date.
Source-reported cumulative wafer-processing passes (片次) processed by a stated single tool; not necessarily distinct wafers.
Sales to the disclosed customer rank or aggregate within the company reporting perimeter; anonymized ranks are specific to each reporting period.
Disclosed customer sales as a percentage of annual total sales, with rank/aggregate retained. A top-five-related-parties row retains the issuer’s annual-total-sales denominator.
Purchases from disclosed supplier ranks or aggregates. This is procurement concentration evidence, not equipment cost or foreign-content measurement.
Disclosed supplier purchases as a percentage of annual total purchases; related top-five purchases retain annual-total-purchases denominator. Not foreign-content share.
Disclosed workforce or workforce-beneficiary person count, with mandatory population/cohort. Use stock only for an explicit as-of basis; annual labels and period payee counts retain period_status.
Source-reported workforce subgroup share of the disclosed employee population. Preserve period/as-of basis and subgroup; do not derive absent shares.
Source-reported share of company revenue within the stated category or geographic reporting boundary. Residual geography is not assumed to mean overseas.
Consolidated balance-sheet contract liabilities at the stated date. Not total orders or order backlog.
Cash paid to acquire or construct fixed assets, intangible assets and other long-term assets as reported in the cash-flow statement. Not accounting PP&E additions or acquisition payments.
Inventory carrying amount on the consolidated balance sheet at the stated date, net of applicable valuation allowances; not inventory gross cost or equipment unit count.

Normally the income-statement line 其中：对联营企业和合营企业的投资收益; also carries the per-investee rows of the long-term-equity-investment movement note (权益法下确认的投资损益), which state the same concept for one named associate. The reporting scope distinguishes them: a company-level scope is the aggregate, a per-investee scope is one component of it, so the two must never be summed together. The figure always belongs to the holder that recognised it, never to the investee.

Issuer-reported R&D investment divided by revenue; a financial intensity ratio, not a bounded component share of revenue.

Issuer-reported year-on-year relative percentage change in attributable net profit; not reconstructed from rounded levels.

Issuer-reported investment amount in the stated equity investment scope.
Issuer-reported gain or loss from the stated equity investment scope.

Issue price per share for the stated equity offering.

Gross proceeds of the stated equity offering before issuance costs.
Issuer-reported gross profit for the stated company or product scope; not derived from revenue and margin.
Issuer-reported absolute change in gross profit from the comparative period.
Issuer-reported year-on-year relative change in gross profit.
Issuer-reported absolute change in interest income from the comparative period.
Net proceeds of the stated equity offering after issuance costs, as reported.
Issuer-reported absolute change in new orders from the comparative period.

Source-reported count of processes undergoing validation for the stated platform during the disclosure context; this does not assert successful validation and is not a process-node count.

Issuer-reported year-on-year relative change in R&D investment.

Source-reported equipment-order threshold in its stated disclosure or event-window context. It is not closing backlog, lifetime cumulative orders, an as-of stock, or a basis for converting chambers and systems.
Issuer-reported absolute change in revenue from the comparative period.
Issuer-reported share-based payment expense for the period.
Issuer-reported absolute change in share-based payment expense from the comparative period.

Issuer-described net proceeds from an equity offering under the source wording and reporting perimeter; distinct source-table scopes must be retained when the deduction basis or amount conflicts with a detailed proceeds-after-costs table.
Issuer-reported after-tax other comprehensive income attributable to owners of the parent; distinct from total other comprehensive income including noncontrolling interests.
Issuer-reported relative change in total assets from the preceding fiscal year-end to the current reporting-period end; not a year-on-year change.
Issuer-reported relative change in equity attributable from the preceding fiscal year-end to the current reporting-period end; not a year-on-year change.

Issuer-reported absolute change in the non-recurring gain/loss effect on net profit attributable to listed-company shareholders from the comparative period; source classification is retained and the value is not reconstructed.
Issuer-reported number of ordinary shareholders at the stated date; does not identify beneficial owners.

Issuer-reported share quantity under the named shareholder table, holder label and holding column. The printed holder/account name is not treated as a beneficial owner or persistent entity identity. Overlapping table columns remain non-additive.
Issuer-reported holding percentage for the named holder/account in the stated shareholder table; not a beneficial-ownership inference.
Issuer-reported long-term borrowings carrying amount at the stated balance-sheet date, corresponding exactly to source line 长期借款.

Issuer-reported profit realized by the combined entity before a business combination under common control, for the stated current or comparative reporting period; distinct from issuer consolidated net profit.

Issuer-reported change field for R&D investment as a share of revenue where the source labels the change column percent rather than percentage points. Preserve the source unit; do not merge with explicit percentage-point change disclosures or interpret as relative growth.
Issuer-reported year-on-year relative change in expensed R&D investment under the stated R&D-investment table perimeter.
Issuer-reported year-on-year relative change in capitalized R&D investment under the stated R&D-investment table perimeter.
Issuer-reported capitalized R&D investment as a share of total R&D investment under the stated table perimeter.
Issuer-reported absolute year-on-year change in the capitalized share of R&D investment, expressed in percentage points.

Issuer-reported gross research and development expenditure before the source-stated government-grant offset; distinct from management-table R&D investment, net R&D expenditure, statement R&D expense and named-project spending.
Issuer-reported government-grant amount offset against R&D expenditure in the stated reconciliation; a deduction component, not government-grant income or gross R&D spending.
Issuer-reported R&D expenditure net of the source-stated government-grant offset; distinct from gross R&D expenditure, income-statement R&D expense and capitalized development expenditure.
Issuer-reported portion of net R&D expenditure recorded in R&D expense in the stated reconciliation; not the gross expensed R&D-investment component.
Issuer-reported portion of net R&D expenditure capitalized as development expenditure in the stated reconciliation; not automatically the gross capitalized R&D-investment component.
Issuer-reported year-on-year relative percentage change in profit before tax; not reconstructed from rounded levels.
Issuer-reported gain or loss from acquisition cost below the acquirer's share of identifiable net assets, as classified in the source non-recurring gain/loss table.
Issuer-reported other item meeting the source definition of non-recurring gain or loss; preserve the issuer classification rather than combining it with other non-operating income and expense.
Issuer-reported non-current assets due within one year at the stated balance-sheet date, corresponding exactly to source line 一年内到期的非流动资产.
Issuer-reported carrying amount of other equity instrument investments at the stated balance-sheet date, corresponding exactly to source line 其他权益工具投资.
Issuer-reported advance receipts carrying amount at the stated balance-sheet date, corresponding exactly to source line 预收款项.
Issuer-reported treasury-share contra-equity carrying amount at the stated balance-sheet date. Retain the positive printed magnitude from source line 减：库存股 rather than manufacturing a negative value.
Issuer-reported other comprehensive income that cannot be reclassified into profit or loss, net of tax, for the reporting period.
Issuer-reported fair-value change in other equity instrument investments within other comprehensive income, net of tax, for the reporting period.
Issuer-reported net cash paid to acquire subsidiaries and other business units during the reporting period; a cash-flow line distinct from investment purchases and capital expenditure.
Issuer-reported new intellectual-property applications during the reporting period for the stated source-native IP class.
Issuer-reported newly obtained intellectual-property grants or registrations during the reporting period for the stated source-native IP class.
Issuer-reported cumulative intellectual-property applications in the stated annual-report context and source-native IP class; no exact as-of date is inferred.
Issuer-reported cumulative intellectual-property grants or registrations in the stated annual-report context and source-native IP class; no exact as-of date is inferred.
Issuer-reported receivables-financing carrying amount at the stated balance-sheet date, corresponding exactly to source line 应收款项融资.
Issuer-reported short-term borrowings carrying amount at the stated balance-sheet date, corresponding exactly to source line 短期借款.
Issuer-reported current monthly dispatch capacity measured in probe pins for the stated probe-card family. This is not probe-card output, achieved shipments, installed base, or ATE capacity.
Issuer-reported relative improvement in operating efficiency of the stated internal manufacturing equipment after modification; not customer-tool performance or wafer throughput.
Issuer-reported test-frequency capability for the stated probe-card product or configuration; not operating frequency of the tested chip.

Issuer-reported number of parallel test sites (site, 工位) for the stated probe-card or test-handler configuration. A current specification, not a target for a product under development and not sockets, channels or pins.
Issuer-reported customer count in a disclosure-period context where no exact as-of date is stated; not persistent customer identities or independently verified active customers.

Issuer-reported count of the company’s internal MEMS production lines in the disclosure-period context, distinguished by source-native wafer-line size; not customer production lines or equipment shipments.

Issuer-reported share of total assets for the stated financial-statement line at the stated balance-sheet date, exactly as the source table labels 占总资产的比例; not a revenue, market, geography or ownership share.

Issuer-reported relative change in the stated financial-statement line from the preceding fiscal year-end to the current fiscal year-end, exactly as the source table labels 本期期末金额较上期期末变动比例; not recalculated.
Issuer-reported total foreign assets at the stated date; does not identify a country, entity, customer, foreign revenue or export destination.
Issuer-reported foreign-assets share of total assets at the stated date.
Issuer-reported restricted-asset book balance (账面余额) at the stated date; distinct from carrying value.
Issuer-reported restricted-asset carrying value (账面价值) at the stated date; distinct from book balance.
Issuer-reported notes payable carrying amount at the stated balance-sheet date, corresponding exactly to source line 应付票据.
Issuer-reported non-recurring gain or loss from fund-occupation fees charged to non-financial enterprises, corresponding to the exact source line 计入当期损益的对非金融企业收取的资金占用费.
Issuer-reported non-recurring debt-restructuring gain or loss for the reporting period, corresponding to source line 债务重组损益.

Issuer-reported test-data-rate capability or project target for the stated equipment/product scope and maturity. Preserve delivered-product versus R&D-project boundaries; not chip operating frequency, qualification, shipment, or production use.
Issuer-reported vector-generation clock/frequency element for the stated tester project. Keep interleaving count separate and do not derive an aggregate data rate.
Issuer-reported interleaving-way count for the stated tester architecture; not parallel test sites, channels, tools, or customers.
Issuer-reported signal-transmission data-rate capability or requirement for the stated interconnect/project scope; not delivered-product maturity or qualification.
Issuer-reported programmable vector allocation/transfer data-rate capability for the stated tester project; distinct from physical-link transmission rate despite equal values.
Issuer-reported stable operating-temperature range for the stated equipment/product scope.
Issuer-reported current-carrying capability or threshold for the stated equipment/product scope; preserve inequality and maturity.

Issuer-reported cost-component share of the total cost across the peer groups in the specified source cost-analysis table. The denominator is the source-table total across all displayed industry groups or all displayed product groups, not the cost subtotal within one business group.

Issuer-reported ratio of system channel count to a source-stated comparator. The comparator identity and basis must remain in the reporting scope; a value of 1.5 means 'is 1.5 times', not 'higher by 1.5 times', and is not independently benchmarked.

Issuer-reported monetary total of an executed contract or explicitly cumulative series of executed contracts at the exact source-defined contract scope and tax basis; not new orders, order backlog, recognized revenue, cash receipts, delivered value, or an allocation among counterparties/products.

Issuer-reported contract amount based on customer-estimated procurement quantity and contingent on actual purchase orders. It is not firm order intake, backlog, recognized revenue, delivered value, cash receipts, or a guaranteed purchase amount.

Source-reported expected duration for completing equipment delivery under a contract, contingent on the stated execution or purchase-order basis. It is a planned window, not elapsed delivery time, a completed delivery, or a guaranteed schedule.
Cash received by a subsidiary from noncontrolling shareholders’ investment, as separately disclosed in the financing cash-flow statement; not total equity-financing cash receipts.
Signed income or loss from derecognition of financial assets measured at amortized cost, as separately reported in the income statement; distinct from equity-method investment income.

Issuer-reported change field for the capitalized share of R&D investment where the source labels the change column percent rather than percentage points. Preserve the source unit; do not merge with explicit percentage-point change disclosures or interpret as relative growth.

Issuer-reported non-GAAP net profit after excluding the effect of share-based payment expense, without an asserted shareholder-attribution perimeter; distinct from net profit attributable to listed-company shareholders and from net profit excluding non-recurring gains and losses.

Issuer-reported year-on-year relative change in non-GAAP net profit after excluding the effect of share-based payment expense, without an asserted shareholder-attribution perimeter; not reconstructed from rounded levels.
Issuer-reported year-on-year relative change in the financial-statement line identified by the reporting scope; not recalculated.
Issuer-reported ownership percentage for the named equity-investment scope; not revenue, market share or investment return.
Issuer-reported year-on-year relative change in total external equity-investment amount.
Issuer-reported total operating revenue subtotal (营业总收入); distinct from the component row 营业收入 even when values are equal.

Issuer-reported signed treasury-share contra-equity amount when the source balance sheet itself prints a negative value; preserves the signed presentation and is distinct from the positive-magnitude treasury_shares metric.
Source-reported reaction-station count in customer production-line mass production for the stated cohort; not systems, reactors, shipments, orders or an independently verified installed base.
Source-reported distinct new equipment models under development in the stated R&D portfolio; not qualified platforms or commercial products.
Source-reported reactor count in mass-production use for the stated equipment/process cohort; not systems, reaction stations, shipments or orders.
Issuer-reported etch depth-to-width aspect ratio for the stated process and product scope; maturity and validation context remain in the reporting scope and evidence.
Issuer-reported process selectivity ratio for the explicitly named material pair and product/application scope; not etch aspect ratio or production qualification.
Issuer-reported annual-average revenue growth over the source-stated trailing history; not a recalculated CAGR and not assigned exact start/end years unless disclosed.
Issuer-reported absolute change in R&D investment versus the comparative period; not R&D expense unless the source explicitly equates them.
Issuer-reported absolute change in the financial-statement line identified by the reporting scope; not recalculated from rounded narrative values.
Issuer-reported after-tax net gain from the named equity disposal in the stated period; distinct from gross proceeds, pre-tax disposal gain and the exact non-recurring asset-disposal line.

Source-reported count of distinct equipment models released or in production application at the stated disclosure date, with product family and maturity wording retained in reporting scope and notes; not models merely under development, platforms, or units shipped.
Source-reported cumulative equipment systems sold to the explicitly stated customer cohort; sales are not shipments, installations, active installed base or recognized revenue.

Issuer-stated maximum process temperature for a named equipment model or family; a capability specification, not measured operating temperature, achieved production, wafer-node capability or a temperature range.

Issuer-stated maximum temperature capability of a named equipment family when the source describes equipment maximum temperature without specifying a process-temperature setpoint; not measured operating temperature, achieved production, wafer-node capability or a temperature range.

Issuer-reported monetary amount labelled production volume in a source sales/production/inventory table; valuation basis is source-defined or unstated, not physical units, nameplate capacity or recognized revenue.
Issuer-reported monetary amount labelled inventory volume in a source sales/production/inventory table; not physical units or automatically consolidated balance-sheet net inventory carrying amount.
Issuer-printed year-on-year relative change in the source-table monetary production amount; not physical production growth.
Issuer-printed year-on-year relative change in the source-table monetary inventory amount; not physical inventory growth.

Ordinal position of a completed equipment-system delivery milestone reported within the disclosure period; not an exact closing cumulative total, annual deliveries, installations or active installed base.
Source-reported cumulative whole equipment systems delivered to customers at the stated date or report context; not chamber shipments, installations, active installed base or annual sales.
Issuer-stated optional chamber count supported by a named equipment family or configuration; a product capability, not chambers shipped, installed or necessarily the maximum configurable count.
Issuer-reported current-period new orders as a multiple of new orders in the corresponding prior-year period; the printed multiple is retained rather than converted to relative percentage growth.

Issuer-reported share of incremental new orders from an explicitly named customer or application component within a stated new-orders basket; retain the denominator in source scope and the component in business_mix.

Issuer-reported average customer-line equipment uptime for the stated equipment family during the disclosure context. A bounded operating percentage, not lifetime reliability, manufacturing capacity, tool count or an independently measured benchmark.

Issuer-reported aggregate value already performed under one exact source-defined contract row through the stated observation context (合计已履行金额). Performance is not automatically revenue recognition, cash collection, equipment delivery, installation, or a system count.
Issuer-reported value performed during the stated report period under one exact source-defined contract row (本报告期履行金额); not automatically period revenue, cash collection, or equipment delivery.

Issuer-reported value remaining to be performed under one exact source-defined contract row (待履行金额) in the disclosure context. This is not issuer-wide order backlog or a receivable, and may differ from equipment still to be delivered.

Issuer-reported count of source-described wafer-manufacturing factories or manufacturers that a specific equipment subtype has entered during the disclosure context. The 家/厂 wording does not resolve distinct corporate customers versus fab sites. This is not installed, accepted or production-use equipment count.

Issuer-stated number of wafers a specified equipment configuration can process simultaneously in a batch; a tool configuration capability, not hourly throughput, factory production capacity, wafer passes or tool shipments.

Issuer-stated wafer processing throughput of a specified equipment model or configuration in wafers per hour, preserving equality or lower-bound wording. A tool capability, not factory tools-per-year output, wafers shipped or customer production volume.

Issuer-stated count of distinct process applications supportable by a source-defined equipment-family basket during the report context. A claimed capability breadth, not tool models, installed tools, qualified processes at every customer, or process nodes.

Issuer-reported wafer-processing quantity performed by a stated equipment fleet on customer production lines over either a stated period or cumulatively. Source 流片量 does not prove distinct wafer identities and must not be assigned to one tool or equated with equipment shipments. Native terms include 流片量 and 过货量.

Issuer-stated configured or maximum number of independent reaction/deposition stations in one chamber of a source-defined tool configuration. Not station shipments, installed stations, chamber count, or factory output.

Issuer-stated relative mechanical throughput/capacity improvement of a stated tool-platform design against its unstated baseline. It is a product-design gain, not factory equipment-production capacity or measured customer output.

Issuer-stated planned gross building floor area of a named factory project. A future construction specification, not current completed area, installed equipment, tools-per-year capacity or wafer output.

Issuer-stated percentage coverage of a source-defined set of cleaning process applications by an equipment family. The denominator and verification protocol may be unstated; this is not market share, yield, process-node coverage or the absolute count of processes.

Issuer-stated chamber count in a specified equipment configuration or architecture. A physical tool specification, not an optional chamber count unless stated, and not chambers shipped, installed or factory output.
Issuer-stated cutting speed of a specified dicing or scribe-and-break tool for the named substrate; not factory production capacity or wafer processing throughput.

Issuer-stated coating or adhesive-film thickness compatible with a named equipment family or process workflow. Compatibility does not imply that the equipment itself applies the coating, or prove process-node capability.

Issuer-stated particle size in a cleaning test, removal, or control capability claim; the exact test verb and cleaning subtype remain in the source scope. This is a particle-size measurement, not a semiconductor process node.
Issuer-stated number of randomly sampled groups for a specified technical test. The group composition and statistical design are not inferred.
Issuer-stated upper percentage bound for an etch-consistency result in a specified technical test; the exact statistic is not inferred if absent from the source.
Issuer-stated range of wafer diameters for a source-defined equipment family or application basket; not a process-node range or unit shipment count.

Issuer-reported average realized sales price per specialized equipment system in the exact reporting-period source basket; not list price, contract face value, revenue, or a derived quotient from rounded totals.

Source-reported fraction of specialized-equipment systems sold into the stated application cohort among all specialized-equipment systems sold across all application fields in the same year; based on unit counts, not revenue or market share.

Issuer-reported amount of source-selected sales orders grouped by the displayed customer row across the source-stated ordering months. Selection thresholds and grouping are source-specific; not issuer-wide new orders, year-total order intake, closing backlog, recognized revenue, or a single contract value unless explicitly one order.

Source-printed ratio of the filing-defined sales quantity to filing-defined production quantity for the exact source product/period. Preserve the source definitions of numerator and denominator; a ratio above 100% can reflect acceptance of equipment dispatched in an earlier period. Not equipment utilization or company gross margin.

Issuer-reported non-binding customer purchase intentions outstanding at the stated date, expressed in reported equipment counts or monetary amounts. No signed agreement, backlog, recognized revenue or probability-weighted forecast is implied. Units and customer/product scope must be preserved.

Source-reported signed absolute change in an equipment-count stock between explicit comparison dates. The underlying_metric dimension distinguishes signed order backlog from non-binding purchase intentions. Not gross new orders, a closing level, relative growth, or a change calculated by the Atlas.

Source-reported percentage of an equipment-count stock attributable to the numerator reporting scope, within the explicit denominator_scope_id at the same stock date. underlying_metric distinguishes signed backlog from non-binding intentions. Not market share, revenue share or a calculated Atlas estimate.

Issuer-reported contract-liability subtotal after an explicitly named counterparty exclusion, as defined by the reporting scope. Not the consolidated balance-sheet contract-liability line or orders on hand; preserve source-reported adjustment rather than calculating it.

Issuer-reported elapsed equipment acceptance-cycle duration in native months for a source-defined cohort or individual machine. Required statistic distinguishes mean from individual duration. Reporting period identifies the observed cohort, not the start/end dates of each cycle. Not uptime, procurement lead time or a duration calculated by the Atlas.

Issuer-reported elapsed customer equipment-validation duration at an explicit snapshot date, in native months. Not a completed acceptance-cycle duration, an installation count or an inferred date of completion; subsequent narrative updates do not overwrite the stated snapshot.

Issuer-reported production capacity utilization level for the stated manufacturing scope and period, preserving the issuer denominator methodology. Not nameplate capacity, sales-to-production ratio, installed-base utilization or a change in utilization. May exceed 100% against nominal capacity; do not infer tool counts or comparable denominator methods across firms.

A stated PRICE RANGE for a tool category or product line, recorded with relation 'range', value as the lower bound and upper_value as the upper. Distinct from reported_average_equipment_selling_price, which is an issuer's realized period average for its own basket. A range is a list or indicative price band and may be stated by an issuer about its own products or by a third party about a category; claim_kind carries which. Never a realized average, never a revenue quotient, and the bounds must not be averaged to manufacture a point estimate.

Issuer-reported number of its own tools operating at customer sites during the disclosure period for the stated equipment scope; a fleet-in-service status, not cumulative shipments, cumulative installations, cumulative deliveries or lifetime sales, and carrying no as-of date unless the source states one.

Issuer-stated pre-bond alignment accuracy of a named bonding equipment model or series, preserving the source's inequality and its stated statistical basis such as 3σ. A tool capability specification for the alignment achieved before bonding, not the placement error surviving the bond, not a wafer distortion, not a process node and not a particle size. Rows in nanometre and micrometre are not interchangeable: the atlas treats the two as separate unit dimensions so no silent conversion can occur.

Issuer-stated post-bond placement or bonding accuracy of a named bonding equipment model or series, preserving the source's inequality and statistical basis. This is the positional error surviving the bond, distinct from the pre-bond alignment capability. Where a source decomposes it into translational, rotational and scaling components, only the translational components belong here; the atlas has no unit dimension for microradian or ppm. Rows in nanometre and micrometre are not interchangeable.

Issuer-stated wafer distortion induced by or remaining after a bonding process, for a named equipment model, series or enabling technology, preserving the source's inequality and statistical basis. Distortion is a deformation of the wafer, not a positional alignment or placement error.

Issuer-stated smallest defect or surface particle an inspection tool can detect at a stated configuration, as the source prints it, for example 最小灵敏度. A detection limit of an inspection tool, not a removal capability, not a design rule or process node, not an imaging resolution and not a measurement repeatability. Where a source makes throughput conditional on sensitivity, the paired sensitivity belongs in the reporting scope or notes. Rows in nanometre and micrometre are not interchangeable.

Issuer-stated repeatability precision of a metrology tool: the standard deviation of repeated measurements of the same feature at the same location, as the source defines it, for example 重复性精度. A smaller value is better, so this metric must never be ranked or aggregated as though larger were better. An instrument precision, not a detection limit, not an imaging resolution and not a process-uniformity bound.

Issuer-stated imaging resolution of an electron-beam or optical inspection or metrology tool, as the source prints it, for example 分辨率, preserving equality or bound wording. The resolving power of the imaging system, not the smallest defect the tool can detect and not its measurement repeatability.

Issuer-stated total thickness variation a named thinning or grinding tool achieves on a stated wafer diameter, preserving the source's bound wording. A tool capability for wafer flatness after processing, not a measured customer result, not a metrology instrument's precision and not a coating thickness.

Issuer-stated wafer thickness window a named tool or process is stated to handle, preserving the source's range wording. A workpiece compatibility window, not a flatness result the tool achieves and not a coating thickness.

Issuer-stated cut width, kerf or scribe-line width of a named dicing tool for the stated substrate, preserving the source's bound wording and recording in the scope or notes whether a heat-affected zone is included. Where a source writes a bound together with a tolerance, such as ≤20±5μm, only the printed bound is recorded, because the implied worst case is not a number the source prints and the atlas does not store derived values; the tolerance is stated in the notes so the row is not read as a guaranteed maximum.

Issuer-stated maximum chipping at the cut edge for a named dicing tool or process, preserving the source's bound wording. An edge-quality outcome of singulation, distinct from the width of the cut itself.

Issuer-stated aspect ratio of the three-dimensional structure a metrology or inspection tool can measure through, preserving the source's bound wording. A capability of the measuring instrument, describing the structure it can see into; it is not the aspect ratio an etch process can produce, and it is not itself a measurement of the structure.

Issuer-stated unaudited forecast of revenue for a stated reporting period, as a point or range and before the period report is filed. Guidance, never an actual flow; superseded by the period report rather than revised by it.

Issuer-stated unaudited forecast of net profit attributable to listed-company shareholders for a stated reporting period, as a point or range and before the period report is filed. Guidance, never an actual flow.
Issuer-stated planned total investment of a named capacity or facility project, whether or not funded by an offering. A plan, not spending; not an R&D budget and not an equipment budget.

Issuer-stated budget line for equipment purchase and installation inside a named investment project. A plan, not orders or spending, and the source label decides whether software, installation or test gear is included.

Issuer-reported commitments contracted but not yet recognised in the financial statements, for acquiring long-term assets, at the stated balance-sheet date. Covers all long-term assets, not only equipment.
Issuer-stated total consideration for an acquisition that is signed but still needs regulatory or shareholder approval. Not completed investment spending.

Minimum annual revenue of an acquisition target committed by its sellers under a performance-compensation agreement, for a stated future year. A contingent commitment, not a forecast by the issuer and not an actual.
Budget of a named construction-in-progress project as printed in the 重要在建工程项目 note. Not cash spent and not CIP.
Issuer-reported engineering progress or cumulative-input share of budget for a named construction-in-progress project at the stated date.

Issuer-reported year-on-year relative change in orders on hand (在手订单) at the stated disclosure date or other explicit as-of date; not recomputed from two backlog rows, and not the growth of new orders.
R&D investment for a named business field, summing with its sibling fields to company R&D investment. Not a company-wide figure, not income-statement R&D expense and not named-project spending.

Equipment the issuer says it delivered (已交付) during the stated period, in whole systems. Delivery, not dispatch: not shipments, acceptances, installations or recognised revenue, and not a cumulative count.
Issuer-reported position accuracy of probes across a whole probe card, recorded as an upper bound on the magnitude. A capability claim, not qualification.
Issuer-stated minimum line width, line/space or resolution of a named exposure tool, preserving the source term (最小线宽, 最小解析, L/S). A published capability, not a process node or a production result.
Issuer-stated overlay or registration accuracy of a named exposure tool. A bare ± is le on the magnitude. Not a bonding alignment figure.
